description: Source code for device descriptor handling, including downloading and validating whitelist and blacklist files, with background task management and system property updates.

methods.name: deviceServiceDeviceDescriptorsInit
methods.description: Initializes device descriptor handling, retrieves last known whitelist and blacklist URLs, and ensures they are downloaded.

methods.name: deviceServiceDeviceDescriptorsDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels scheduled updates for device descriptors.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsUpdateWhitelist
methods.description: Starts or updates the background task to download and validate the whitelist file from a URL.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsUpdateBlacklist
methods.description: Starts or updates the background task to download and validate the blacklist file from a URL.

methods.name: cancelWhitelistUpdate
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing whitelist update task and URL request.

methods.name: updateWhitelistTaskFunc
methods.description: Background task function to download and validate whitelist, update system properties, and notify readiness.

methods.name: cancelBlacklistUpdate
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing blacklist update task and URL request.

methods.name: updateBlacklistTaskFunc
methods.description: Background task function to download and validate blacklist, update system properties, and notify updates.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL to a destination path, validating with a provided validator function.

methods.name: fileNeedsUpdating
methods.description: Determines if a file needs to be downloaded based on URL and MD5 checksum comparison.

methods.name: getFileMd5
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 checksum of a local file's contents.
